description: Every modifier the merchant has — the questions the till can ask about an item, with their choices and prices. Start here for anything about options, add-ons, extras, toppings, sizes, milk, cooking temperature or "how do I let them choose X". Each row says how it is answered: "Pick one" (radio), "Pick many" (checkboxes), "Pick many · qty" or "stepper per choice" (the last two count UNITS, so one choice taken three times counts as 3). usedIn is how many categories it is linked to — a modifier with usedIn 0 is invisible at the till no matter how well it is set up.
name: hub_get_modifiers
title: List modifiers
